title: AWS Global Router
description: An ephemeral, on-demand multi-region WireGuard VPN orchestrator delivering 90%+ cost savings over persistent cloud instances and commercial VPN subscriptions. Dynamically provisions disposable AWS cloud gateways with hypervisor-level self-teardown, zero-cost idle warm standby, split-tunnel egress optimization, and real-time DynamoDB cost analytics.
Highlights: 90%+ cost reduction over commercial VPN subscriptions and 24/7 cloud VMs via pay-per-use on-demand gateways ($0.015-$0.025/hr vs $15+/mo)
Warm Standby (Zero-Cost Idle) lifecycle releasing public IPv4 and halting EC2 compute charges while enabling rapid ~10s gateway resumption
Granular 4-tier cost intelligence tracking EC2 compute, public IPv4 ($0.005/hr), EBS storage, and egress bandwidth in AWS DynamoDB with budget alerts
Custom split-tunnel traffic routing with QR code pairing, preserving mobile bandwidth and eliminating costly AWS egress data transfer ($0.09/GB)
Multi-device mesh networking supporting up to 5 concurrent client keypairs per node (10.8.0.2 - 10.8.0.6) with interactive device management
Anonymous Dynamic DNS (DuckDNS) integration ensuring persistent client configs and hidden infrastructure footprint
Hardened REST control plane secured with API key authentication (X-API-Key) and Zero-Trust ingress via Cloudflare Access tunnels
